    "TIER_0": [
        # Capital deployment questions (NEW — replaces labor questions)
        "DEPLOY_BUDGET", "RISK_CAPITAL", "ASSET_SCAN", "ROI_TARGET",
        # Keep sophisticated questions
        "P90_MECHANISM", "ARBITRAGE_WINDOW", "COMPOUND_ASSET",
        "STAIR_STEP_PATH", "SURVIVORSHIP_DELTA", "BRIDGE_CAPITAL",
        # Keep universal
        "LEVERAGE", "KILL_CRITERIA",
    ],
    "TIER_1": [
        # Capital + service hybrid
        "DEPLOY_BUDGET", "ROI_TARGET", "COMPOUND_MECHANISM",
        "SERVICE_FLOOR", "PRODUCT_SEED", "REINVESTMENT", "NETWORK_LEVERAGE", "KILL_CRITERIA",
        # Sophisticated
        "P90_MECHANISM", "ARBITRAGE_WINDOW", "COMPOUND_ASSET", "STAIR_STEP_PATH", "SURVIVORSHIP_DELTA",
        "LEVERAGE",
    ],
    "TIER_2": [
        "WINNER", "KILL", "CUSTOMER", "ECONOMICS", "MOAT",
        "LEVERAGE", "SERVICE_FLOOR", "ROI_TARGET", "COMPOUND_MECHANISM",
    ],
    "TIER_3": [
        "ACQUISITION_TARGET", "INTEGRATION_COST", "OPERATOR_FIT",
        "COMPOUNDING", "EXIT_PATH", "LEVERAGE",
    ],
}


def generate(tier: str, topic: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Generate decision questions for capital tier.

    Args:
        tier: Capital tier (TIER_0, TIER_1, TIER_2, TIER_3)
        topic: Optional topic for context injection

    Returns:
        dict with tier and questions list.
    """
    if tier not in TIER_QUESTION_CODES:
        return {
            "error": f"invalid tier: {tier}",
            "valid_tiers": list(TIER_QUESTION_CODES.keys()),
        }

    codes = TIER_QUESTION_CODES[tier]
    questions = []

    for code in codes:
        q = DECISION_QUESTIONS.get(code)
        if q:
            entry = {
                "code": code,
                "question": q["question"],
                "question_vi": q["question_vi"],
                "kill_signal": q["kill_signal"],
            }

            # Inject topic into question if provided
            if topic:
                entry["question_with_topic"] = q["question"].replace(
                    "this", f"'{topic}'"
                ).replace(
                    "ecosystem", f"'{topic}' ecosystem"
                )

            questions.append(entry)

    return {
        "tier": tier,
        "topic": topic,
        "question_count": len(questions),
        "questions": questions,
        "note": f"Use ONLY these questions for {tier} analysis. Do NOT use standard WINNER/KILL/etc if tier is TIER_0 or TIER_1."
        if tier in ("TIER_0", "TIER_1")
        else None,
    }


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Generate tier-adjusted decision questions for stage0"
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--tier",
        required=True,
        choices=["TIER_0", "TIER_1", "TIER_2", "TIER_3"],
        help="Capital tier",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--topic",
        default=None,
        help="Topic for context injection (optional)",
    )
    args = ap.parse_args()

    result = generate(tier=args.tier, topic=args.topic)
    # Use ensure_ascii=True for Windows console compatibility
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
